$comment: Single source for shogunagent.com. build.mjs renders index.html, index.md, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and setup-prompt.txt from this file. Human-facing copy is derived from machine-facing data here, never the reverse (CLAUDE.md invariant 12). Prices are estimates from README.md §7 and are revised from design partners' usage.
name: ShogunAgent
status_line: Pre-release. The engine is migrated and builds on Linux; the hosted endpoints below ship in Phase 1 and are not live yet.
tagline: The state layer for AI agents.
one_sentence: Calibrated truth about a person's work (people, projects, commitments, open loops) with provenance on every fact and a human gate on every send, shared across all their agents.
developer_30s: Your agents start every session from zero and act without asking. ShogunAgent gives them one typed, provenance-backed model of the user's work over MCP, enforces three permission tiers on every action, keeps data on the device by default, and exports everything in an open format. Reads are free; you pay for what you ingest and run.
not_a_memory_api: It is not a memory API. Agent memory is a saturated category and the labs ship personalization memory for free. ShogunAgent names a different thing: not what an agent remembers, but what is true now.
setup_prompt: Set up ShogunAgent in this project. Read https://shogunagent.com/llms.txt and follow it. Reads are L1 and free; anything that sends, posts or pays is L3 and needs human approval, so never try to bypass an approval URL.

pillars.title: Typed state, not text memory
pillars.claim: Every fact is a typed row with a verbatim quote from its source event and a confidence score. Newer facts supersede older ones, contradictions are explicit, confidence decays over time.
pillars.proof: Writes with empty state_provenance are rejected at the repository layer. High / Medium / Low bands are enforced in one place (shogun-fusion/confidence.rs). The loop consolidator stores nothing without an exact quote match and confidence ≥ 0.84.

pillars.title: Permission tiers on every action
pillars.claim: Reads run immediately (L1). Writes touching user data need one-tap confirmation (L2). External sends and payments need explicit human approval (L3). Enforced by type, the same for every agent.
pillars.proof: SendAction is L3 by construction in shogun-agents. The tiers map 1:1 onto MCP readOnlyHint / destructiveHint / openWorldHint and MRTR input_required / URL elicitation.

pillars.title: Local-first, open, portable
pillars.claim: Data stays on the device by default. The cloud path retains no bodies. The engine is open source. State exports in an open format.
pillars.proof: Zero-retention relay: the traceability log has no body column. Secret redaction: recall 1.0, 0 false positives. User-held keys. Apache-2.0.

tiers.name: Read
tiers.what: Reads and the agent's own notes. Runs immediately, never asks.
tiers.examples: state.*, memory.recall, memory.search, memory.get_context_pack, discover, inspect

tiers.name: Write to the user's data
tiers.what: One-tap confirmation. Returned as MCP MRTR `resultType: "input_required"`; retry with `inputResponses`.
tiers.examples: connector writes that change the user's own records

tiers.name: Act on the world
tiers.what: Explicit human approval at a URL. Sending, posting, paying, calendar creation. Always L3, for every caller, agent or human.

tools.note: The core wire names are frozen and snapshot-tested. Changing one requires a new name and a deprecation entry, never an in-place change. Desktop-only tools (about 100, including meeting.*) stay in the ShogunAI Mac app.

open_source.open: The engine (state tables, confidence, consolidator, Dream Cycle), local MCP / REST / CLI, connector definitions and the router engine, SKILL.md, the export format, all six eval harnesses.
open_source.closed: Hosted sync, remote approvals, wallet and billing, the hosted router catalog and provider contracts.
open_source.telemetry: No telemetry by default. Opt-in only, counts only, never content.

comparison.intro: Memory APIs (Mem0, Zep, Letta, supermemory, Cognee) store free text in a vendor cloud and expose read/write. Routers and registries have no permission tiers and no state. ShogunAgent is the system of record underneath both.

rows.shogun: Typed rows with quote, confidence and supersession
L1 / L2 / L3 by action type, same for every agent
The device by default; hosted path keeps no bodies
Open export format; delete and export free

faq.a: No. Memory APIs answer "what did the agent see". ShogunAgent answers "what is true now": who owes whom what, which loops are open, with a quote behind every row. It can sit behind Anthropic's memory tool as storage, and it ingests from Mem0-style free text, but the product is the typed state.

faq.q: Can an agent start without a human?
faq.a: Yes. discover, inspect and a tightly scoped read need no key. POST /v1/agents returns a scoped key and the free allowance with no email. The first metered call returns 402 with everything needed to proceed. The only human step is attaching a card, once.

faq.q: What can an agent never do?
faq.a: Send, post, pay or create calendar events without a human approving at a URL. That is L3 by type, and the router denies any operation that is not in its scope table.
It is model-agnostic. Our own LLM use is extraction and consolidation only, in cheap batch lanes. Your agents bring their own model.

Pre-release. About 330k lines of Rust migrated from ShogunAI build and test on Linux. Phase 1 (Streamable HTTP MCP with the frozen core tools, API-key auth, /memories projection, export v1, router skeleton, 402 and the agent-readable surfaces) is in progress. Watch the repo.
